entrypoint_inventory.scope: Static source, compiled-captured-runtime and fixture searches are evidence about the listed assemblies only; they do not prove what a later or external deployment loads.

native_source.observed: The current native v1 router mounts the native Stock router and imports none of the three retained candidates. The current app finalizes with validationErrorMiddleware then errorHandler, not errorMiddleware. No current source or checked fixture imports validateBody.

captured_runtime.observed: The captured EC v1 router requires ../compat/material-referentials-backport, mounts augmentMaterialReferentialsAccessProfile at /auth and materialReferentialsBackportRouter at /stock before moduleAccessGate. It contains all three legacy compiled members. The captured app imports validationErrorMiddleware and errorHandler; no static require edge to error.middleware or validate was found in this captured assembly.

fixtures.observed: The material adapter has a direct unit test. Checked fixture apps use their own inline error handlers or current errorHandler/validationErrorMiddleware; this is not operational-deployment proof.
